resources.string: There is no word there. Tap on a word.
%1$s is not in the dictionaries on this device, and the online ones cannot be reached
The app cannot reach the dictionary
Every dictionary source is off. Turn one on in the Dictionary tool\'s settings.
Turn on screen reading to look up words on the screen

Look up a word in any app, on a card over that app. Select the word and tap Look up in the menu, or tap Look up on the floating button and then tap the word. The card asks the dictionary sources above, in their order. From the card you can hear the word, copy it, add it to My words, ask the AI about it, or send it to AnkiDroid as a flashcard.
Look up in the selection menu
Look up shows in other apps\' menu for selected text
Tap a word on the screen
Give the floating button a Look up action. It needs screen reading.
A word from the selection menu always gets the sheet
How a word goes to AnkiDroid
Straight to the deck when AnkiDroid lets WM Keyboard add to it, else AnkiDroid\'s editor, filled in
Straight to the deck. The first time, WM Keyboard asks for AnkiDroid\'s permission.
AnkiDroid\'s note editor opens, filled in, and you save the note there. Needs no permission.
Offer %1$s in the Dictionary\'s Open in menu
Its address with %s where the word goes, such as https://example.com/search?q=%s. Shown in the Open in menu by its name.
The speaker plays people saying the word, from Wiktionary and Forvo

When you tap the speaker beside a word, the keyboard looks for recordings of real people saying it: the audio files on Wiktionary, from Wikimedia Commons and Lingua Libre, in the word\'s language. Forvo is asked too when you add your own Forvo key. Each voice gets a chip under the word, named by its accent or its speaker, so you can pick another one. When nobody has recorded the word, the phone\'s own voice reads it as before.
A word you played once plays again with no connection
Optional. Get a key at api.forvo.com to add Forvo\'s voices. It is never put in a backup.
Made on first use. A note type named WM Keyboard Look-up is made too.
